description: We are a passionate student team interested in space science, physics, and tech, gearing up for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026! Our goal is to build creative, practical solutions using NASA’s open data. We welcome motivated collaborators skilled in programming, web dev, data analysis, UI/UX design, research, and presentation. You don’t need to be an expert—creativity, commitment, teamwork, and a drive to learn matter most. Let’s build solutions that make a difference!
